title: fix(app-shell): draw a served report, page or dashboard label as served in the Console header, report index and recent list
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBKmABkq9Ha7c3RZSdaCFLLj)_

Fixes #30244

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Console 页眉的报表面包屑和页面标题、应用的报表索引、最近访问列表（报表、页面、仪表盘三类，以及侧边栏里未写标签、指向仪表盘的导航项）改为直接显示服务端返回的标签；只有服务端没给标签时才去查客户端词典。
- 为什么改：客户在 `.custom` 覆盖包里给已安装包的报表或仪表盘改了名，服务端按 #30193 的顺序返回新名字，Studio 也显示新名字；但 Console 拿着服务端的标签去查词典，词典里基础包的旧译名又把它盖了回去，用户在页眉和最近列表看到的是旧名字。
- 风险与回滚：未改动的条目显示不变（服务端本来就用同一份词典翻译过，实测 zh-CN 一致）；切换语言时元数据整体重读，不会残留旧语言。回滚即还原本 PR。页面一项要等 #30062 服务端补上页面的 packagedBase 后才看得出效果；应用标签本 PR 未改，见 Acceptance notes。
- 先看：① `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/AppHeader.tsx` 报表与页面两个分支；② `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useNavTargetLabel.ts` 仪表盘分支（草稿标签仍走词典）；③ `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useRecentItemLabel.ts` 页面与报表分支。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/AppHeader.servedLabels-11295.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useRecentItemLabel.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/AppReportIndex-13020.test.tsx`，预期 3 个文件 49 个测试全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **The rule, at the callers that hold a served document.** A label the `/meta` read (or the app bundle) served is already translated by the server, by its label order for an overridden item (#30193), so it is drawn as given. The catalog key (`useObjectLabel`'s `reportLabel` / `pageLabel` / `dashboardLabel`) is asked only when no served label is at hand: the humanized slug, an item served with no label, a pending draft's label. This is the rule the header's dashboard branch already follows (objectui#11295).
  - `AppHeader.tsx`: the report crumb and the page's phone title.
  - `appReportIndex.ts` (`useAppReportEntries`): a report row's label.
  - `useRecentItemLabel.ts`: a page row and a report row.
  - `useNavTargetLabel.ts`: the dashboard target, which labels a recent dashboard row and an unlabelled sidebar entry that opens a dashboard. A pending draft's label still goes through the catalog.
- **The helpers are unchanged.** `pageLabel`, `reportLabel` and `dashboardLabel` stay the catalog lookup for text no server translated, because some of their callers pass exactly that: `plugin-dashboard`'s `DashboardRenderer` passes a schema's `header.title`, and every caller of `appLabel` passes a keyed label the client translates. Flipping a helper would have changed those callers too. Their docblocks now say that a caller holding a served label draws it as given. Adding a served variant to `useObjectLabel` was weighed and not taken: 148 test files mock `useObjectLabel` with a fixed member list, and the caller-side form needs no new member.
- **Test fixtures that served English in a zh-CN session.** Three suites (`RecentApps.labelAtRender-11678`, `useRecentItemLabel.readsByName-29235`, `useNavigationSync.standardEntryLocalizes-11201`) served an English label in a zh-CN session and let a client catalog key translate over it. The Console's catalog is the server's own `/api/v1/i18n/translations/:locale` answer (`ui/apps/console/src/loadLanguage.ts`), and the server translates a served label with that same catalog, so that world does not occur: measured on the showcase, `pages.showcase_task_schedule` is absent from the server's zh-CN catalog and the page is served in English; `pages.showcase_capability_map` is present and the page is served as 能力地图. The fixtures now serve what the server serves in that language; each suite's assertion is unchanged.

## Per-caller reading (what each caller holds)

| Caller | What it holds | Where it comes from | Verdict |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `AppHeader` report crumb | the report document | `metadata.reports` (`/meta/report`), translated by the server | served: drawn as given |
| `AppHeader` page title | the page document | the app bundle, else `/meta/page` by name | served: drawn as given |
| `useAppReportEntries` | the report document | `metadata.reports` | served: drawn as given |
| `useRecentItemLabel` page / report | the page / report document | the app bundle or `/meta` by name | served: drawn as given |
| `useNavTargetLabel` dashboard | the dashboard document, else a pending draft row | the app bundle or `/meta/dashboard`; `_drafts` | served: as given; draft: catalog, as before |

A language switch does not leave a served label stale: `ConsoleShell` clears the adapter cache and remounts `MetadataProvider` with `key={language}`, and the app bundle reads live inside it, so every served label is read again in the new language.

## Tests

- New: one top-level describe in `AppHeader.servedLabels-11295.test.tsx` (report crumb and page title, en and zh-CN, renamed / unedited / not served / no catalogue entry); one in `useRecentItemLabel.test.tsx` (report, page and dashboard each on its own cell, plus controls); one in `AppReportIndex-13020.test.tsx` (renamed, unedited, served with no label). Controls: an item the read did not serve, or served with no label, is still named by the catalog key; en with no catalogue entry keeps the humanized slug or machine name.
- Ablation (the four source files restored to `origin/main` `31260ca8` with `git restore --source`, markers counted at 0 on disk, restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, `git status` clean after): 8 failed | 41 passed. The 8 are exactly the renamed cells (report crumb en/zh, page title en/zh, report index, recent report, recent page, recent dashboard); every control stayed green.

<details><summary>Test runs</summary>

- New pins, fix in place: `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 49 passed (49)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Ablation leg: `Test Files 3 failed (3)`, `Tests 8 failed | 41 passed (49)`.
- Consumer sweep (124 app-shell test files that import the four changed modules, render `AppHeader`, `UnifiedSidebar`, Home, the report index or the recent surfaces): `Test Files 3 failed | 121 passed (124)`, `Tests 4 failed | 936 passed (940)`. The 4 reds were the three fixture suites above; after the fixture change: `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 11 passed (11)`.
- 30 more test files carrying a zh-CN dashboard, page or report fixture: `Test Files 30 passed (30)`, `Tests 290 passed (290)`.
- After merging `origin/main` (head 0aa33ca0), the touched suites plus the whole `@object-ui/i18n` package: `Test Files 101 passed (101)`, `Tests 1503 passed | 13 skipped (1516)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`. `eslint` on the changed files: 0 errors.

</details>

## Live (showcase, zh-CN)

The CRM example ships no report, so the live leg ran on the showcase (`pnpm dev -- --fresh`, the Console from `ui/` src through Vite). Overrides were written the way Studio's Customize writes them: `POST /api/v1/packages/com.example.showcase/ensure-customization` (pair `com.example.showcase.custom`), then `PUT /meta/TYPE/NAME?package=com.example.showcase.custom&mode=draft` with `overrides: { package: 'com.example.showcase', basedOn: '0.1.0' }` and a new `label`, then publish.

| Served under `Accept-Language: zh-CN` | Before the override | After the override |
|:--|:--|:--|
| report `showcase_hours_by_status` (item and list) | 按状态统计工时（汇总） | Effort by Status (renamed-30244) |
| dashboard `showcase_ops_dashboard` | 交付运营 | Delivery Cockpit (renamed-30244) |
| page `showcase_capability_map` | 能力地图 | 能力地图 (en serves the override) |

The report and the dashboard follow the #30193 order on `main`. The page does not yet: the server passes no `packagedBase` for a page (`PACKAGED_BASE_ACCESSORS` lists object, dashboard, view and report), which is #30062's server half. The page caller takes the same rule anyway; it is unmeasurable until #30062 lands, with the reading above as its before.

| Console, zh-CN, same overrides | `origin/main` ui | this branch |
|:--|:--|:--|
| header crumb on the report | 按状态统计工时（汇总） | Effort by Status (renamed-30244) |
| report index row | 按状态统计工时（汇总） | Effort by Status (renamed-30244) |
| sidebar recent: report / dashboard / page | 按状态统计工时（汇总） / 交付运营 / 能力地图 | Effort by Status (renamed-30244) / Delivery Cockpit (renamed-30244) / 能力地图 |
| Studio item properties | | Effort by Status (renamed-30244) |

## Acceptance notes

- **App labels are left as they are.** The card's Wanted box names the app document too. On `main` the server passes no `packagedBase` for an app either, so an overridden app is served the base's translation today and the Console agrees with it. The app callers (about sixteen: the header, the app switcher, the sidebar, Home, AI chat, the no-access state and the report index's other-apps list) pass `resolveKeyedI18nLabel(app.label, t)`, which may be a keyed label the client translates, so a served-first rule there has to tell a served string from a keyed label first. Raised to the seat as an open question; it can ride with #30062.
- **Same class, not touched here:** an object's and a list view's label in `useNavTargetLabel` and the recent `object` row (`objectPluralLabel`) still ask the catalog over the served label. The server keeps an overridden object's own text (it passes `packagedBase` for object and view), so a renamed object would show its base translation in the sidebar and recent list. Reported to the seat for a family card.
- The claim's file surface did not list `useNavTargetLabel.ts`; the recent list's dashboard row is labelled through it, so it is touched here.

- Derived gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at 0aa33ca0: 35 commands, each run with its exit code captured before any pipe, all 35 exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 35 derived, 35 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, exit 0. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` ran under `os-verify-lock`.
- Changeset: `.changeset/30244-served-labels-console-header.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell` patch, both declaration lines.
